claim_label: approximate reproduction; training-free crop-group selection diagnostic
parameter_policy: Fixed general rules; no fitting, word dictionary, length prior or parameter search using evaluation annotations
combination: equal-weight geometric means of dimensionless scores in [0,1]
consensus: at most one contribution per originating view
stability: longest consecutive threshold-support interval; Voronoi interval weights
mask_support: mean available whole/tile probabilities on original-image letterbox canvas; soft mass within group reference bbox
assignment: maximum total score; at most one crop per group and one use per original candidate ID; repeated spellings allowed
rejection: only empty normalized readings or zero-scored assignment; no fitted confidence cutoff

cross_parseq.decoding: causal teacher forcing with frozen weights
cross_parseq.unsupported_length: explicit UNSUPPORTED_LENGTH record and zero cross score; never truncate; preserve reading in other selectors

clip.image_preprocessing: median-RGB square canvas followed by pinned official processor; preserve full field of view

templates.written: a photo of the written word "{text}"

scientific_choices.choice: Paper sections 3.3/3.5 use localized crops and PARSeq-S; they do not specify these selectors or CLIP.
Frozen group/crop/PARSeq caches and the previously qualified pinned CLIP snapshot supply diagnostic inputs.

All selection rules, equal weights, soft-mask support, shared-crop assignment, causal likelihood scoring, CLIP views/prompts and field-of-view preprocessing are experimental; no evaluation GT enters selection.
Sequential models and batch 16; optional CPU execution. Cross shortlists (5 words/3 crops) are fixed resource budgets, not accuracy-tuned values.
Dataset transfer, grouping parameter transfer, confidence calibration, residual noise rejection and final selection accuracy remain unqualified until independent evaluation.
